_readme: Battery's calibration sets, pre-registered before any verdict or entry_stage write (COLLECTION.md 4). The stage key is anchored to Battery's OWN case-study posts, which are external documents rather than model opinion -- the property that keeps the test honest when the same model writes and takes it. 'control' in the stage key is not a taxonomy value: it marks a row whose transaction is a control acquisition, for which every round-describing column is meaningless (T3's addendum).

gate_result._run: 2026-09-06, before any verdict or entry_stage write

site_invest_year.verdict: PROMOTED to class 1 for the entry YEAR
site_invest_year.note: Read as a CLOSE year, not an announcement date (the Menlo rule). It may set first_seen; a year disagreement with press never overrides a round word.

site_stage=Buyout.verdict: PROMOTED to class 1 as a CONTROL TRIGGER, not as a stage label
site_stage=Buyout.note: Every Buyout-labelled row in the key is a control acquisition. It routes the row to the T3 control test; it does not by itself decide it.

site_stage=Growth.verdict: PROMOTED to class 1 for 'Growth or control' only
site_stage=Growth.note: No Growth-labelled row in the key entered at Seed or Series A, so the label rules those OUT reliably. But WebPT and Brightree are control positions carrying a Growth label, so a Growth label never exempts a row from the control test.

site_stage=Early.verdict: REFUSED as a label; corroboration only
site_stage=Early.note: The key values behind 'Early' are Seed (HotelTonight), Series A (StreamSets, Guardicore, Gainsight) and Growth (Coupa Series B, BlueKai Series B, Glassdoor Series C, Habana Labs Series B). The bucket is Battery's strategy label describing the company when listed, not the round it entered -- the Accel socure class. Every Early row goes to the judge to find the round.

membership_trap_result.note: 12 of the 15 not_member traps never became base rows: the ex-partner tenure rule and the personal-Section-16 rule removed them structurally, which is the outcome the trap set exists to verify. Three survive as tier-C rows (OOYALA, COMMSCOPE, SEMBIOSYS GENETICS) and must be ruled not_member in the grind; all 7 known-true members are present at tier A.

gate_result.honesty_note: The layer scoring is the load-bearing result and is anchored to external first-party documents (Battery's own case-study posts) rather than model opinion. The judge-side BLIND pass is not claimed: this session wrote the key, so it cannot take the test blind in the same context. What the gate therefore delivers here is COLLECTION.md 4's other and larger job -- deciding the evidence order the grind will use, rather than auditing one it already used.
